description: Every order has an ID, date, customer and channel
Every order line has all its fields
Every customer has an ID, location and signup date
Every product has a name, category, price and cost
order_date is a real date, not in the future
signup_date is a real date, not in the future
quantity and list_price are positive numbers
Every order belongs to a known customer
Every order line belongs to a known order
Every order line refers to a known product
Latest order is no more than 7 days old
